name: kanban_subtask
description: Add, tick, remove or link checklist items on a card. Items nest to any depth and may depend on any other item in the same card.
llm_description: Manage a checklist tree. subtask_add accepts optional parent_subtask_id; subtask_depend links subtask_id to depends_on and off removes that edge. Cycles are rejected.

subtask_id.description: Subtask id, for toggle and remove

parent_subtask_id.description: Optional parent checklist item id for subtask_add; nesting can continue at any depth

room.description: Board room name; omit for the default 'board' room
